key_findings: IGC's official full-time MBA/Master overview lists seven current full-time programs; overview/category pages were not treated as program records.
Central admission requirements were merged into each program because the official site separates key facts pages from shared requirements pages.

Language thresholds split into two main groups: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 90 for IMBA, Logistics, Global Management, and Executive Management; IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 80 for Tourism, Management Digitalization and Transformation, and Aeronautical Management.
No GRE requirement was found. GMAT appears only in the official English-certificate PDF context and was not modeled as an admissions aptitude test.

Common international handling includes APS for Chinese and Vietnamese applicants, India APS for visa appointment rather than first IGC application step, translations, early visa action, and financial resources.
known_gaps: Summer-semester start is official for selected programs, but the read pages did not expose a separate summer application deadline.
MBA in Executive Management title is marked by IGC as a winter 2026/27 title change subject to senatorial approval.
International MBA partner-university specialization rules were summarized from IGC pages; partner institution pages were not used because this task was limited to IGC official sources.
Program fees and discount references are 2026 page facts and should be refreshed before student-facing quoting.
